Growth & demand: A key highlight for the year was the 11.9% growth in Average Transaction Value (ATV), reflecting our continued focus on delivering differentiated, high-value experiences through offerings such as Elite Matrimony and Assisted Services, along with the increasing adoption of longer-tenure subscription plans.

PERFORMANCE OVERVIEW For the year, our matchmaking business revenues remained stable at `455.70 Crore, with modest growth of 1.3%, while subscription volumes saw some moderation at 9.63 Lakhs of paid subscriptions.
On a consolidated basis, revenue growth remained steady at `460 Crore, flat 1% vs last year, while PAT was `34.17 Crore.
Margins & costs: The Earnings before Interest, Tax and Depreciation (EBITDA) for the year was at ` 5,249 as against ` 6,376 Lakhs for the previous year, a decrease of 17.67%.
The matchmaking EBITDA for the year decreased by 6.15% to reach ` 8,650 Lakhs as against ` 9,217 Lakhs of the previous year.
The EBITDA loss for the year was at ` 1,502 Lakhs as compared to the loss of ` 1,451 Lakhs of the previous year.
Capex & expansion: During the year, we made steady progress in building and scaling adjacent businesses: • In Wedding Services, we transitioned towards a commission-led approach, with an initial focus on venue bookings, while continuing to refine product-market fit before scaling. • ManyJobs, India's first Grey Collar Job portal, addressing the hiring gaps in the sales and ser…

We have initiated monetisation while continuing to refine the product and the model for broader expansion into other states. • We revamped Luv.com, our App tailored for singles seeking serious relationships that grows into shared future.
